No, I've rented a room. Earlier I was working from our hometown, from there I got transferred here with a promotion.

For me also, I am going to hometown tomorrow.

I came one month ago to Bangalore.
Actually it's a new place right.

Adjust, don't worry, don't stress. Bangalore is very nice, everyone will adjust.
I came to Bangalore three years ago.

From your previous work, your previous work?
Oh, gold loan, okay, are you into cash, business, sales?

Sales, sales, earlier I was doing operations, there is a lot of pressure there, sales we have to do, operations we have to look after, that's why I am in sales now, here six months has passed since I joined.
Incentives will come, but it's difficult, I am in gold loan, gold loan means, location wise it depends, Kolar, Mangalore, Karnataka, right?
It's easy to get gold loan people.

For work we have to do it.
Yes, there is, baby is there.
Since you came, you didn't go?
Since you came to Bangalore, you didn't go to your hometown?
No, I'll go, I have kept my car ready, whenever I get time I'll go by car, now no training or anything, it's a bit late so I'll go by car.
It's near only, you can go and come back, it's airport, right? If it's this side, it's a bit difficult.
From there you can go, no issue.
Hmm, tomorrow, tomorrow is no leave, tomorrow is a half day, with permission I am going.

Tuesday, otherwise Wednesday I have to come, I want leave, it's been one month since I went home.

Like that nobody is there, if I take 15 days it's gone, here this last month activities, that, this, because of that, leave time also I couldn't go.
I didn't have health either, so I didn't go.
Second Saturday, fourth Saturday normally I go home.
Here only, this time I didn't go anywhere, just in PG, if I go to office or else I stay in room.
What is this, if we go to office we have to go somewhere, feels like that, morning, morning we take one hour.
After that if we come, it's like that.
Tanuku, our team will take, branch they will take, ours is branch banking right?

OD means OD will be there, right?
That customer thing, my boys have to make follow up.
